| awards = }} '''Bismack Biyombo Sumba ''' (born August 28, 1992 in [[Lubumbashi]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]) is a [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese]] professional [[basketball player]]. As of April 19th, 2011, Biyombo was rated the 6th best draft prospect for the [[2011 NBA Draft]] by Draftexpress.com.[http://www.draftexpress.com/rankings/Top-100-Prospects Draftexpress.com Top 100 Prospects.] ==Biography== Biyombo was discovered by the former Jordanian and Angolan national team head coach, Mario Palma, at the age of 16 at a youth tournament in Yemen. Biyombo's play impressed the coach and earned him an opportunity to train in Spain.[http://www.fiba.com/pages/eng/fc/news/lateNews/p/newsid/45604/arti.html FIBA.com Palma not surprised by the new sensation of the ACB, Bismack Biyombo.] Biyombo initially started playing with [[CB Illescas|Illescas]], a team associated with [[Baloncesto Fuenlabrada|Fuenlabrada]], in the [[LEB Plata]], before being called up to the senior team after the transfer of center [[Esteban Batista]].[http://www.fiba.com/pages/eng/fc/news/lateNews/p/newsid/45604/arti.html FIBA.com Palma not surprised by the new sensation of the ACB, Bismack Biyombo.] ==Pro career== Biyombo made his professional debut in the [[Spanish ACB League]] with [[Baloncesto Fuenlabrada|Fuenlabrada]] against [[DKV Joventut]] on January 9th, 2011, and scored 5 points and had 7 rebounds in just 13 minutes of play.[http://www.acb.com/fichas/LACB55131.php ACB.com DKV JOVENTUT|BALONCESTO FUENLABRADA 100|86.] In Fuenlabrada's narrow defeat to [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]], he scored 6 points and blocked 3 shots[http://www.acb.com/fichas/LACB55148.php ACB.com REAL MADRID|BALONCESTO FUENLABRADA 76|75.], one of them against former [[ACB Most Valuable Player Award|Spanish League MVP]] and [[Spanish national basketball team|Spanish national team]] player, [[Felipe Reyes]].[http://www.fiba.com/pages/eng/fc/news/lateNews/p/newsid/45604/arti.html FIBA.com Palma not surprised by the new sensation of the ACB, Bismack Biyombo.] At the 2011 Nike Hoops Summit, Biyombo participated for the World Select Team (against the USA Select Team), and recorded a triple double, with 12 points, 11 rebounds, and 10 blocks. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links==
